assumptions: Lossless UART except RX ring capacity; complete commands of fixed wire length; strict byte credit including every framed byte; pingpong one command; ACK on parser admission, two parsed slots; fixed parser and execution service periods, synthetic ACK size, host delay applied after latest ACK; no real CPU scheduling, hardware FIFO, driver, ACK loss, resend, binary text borrowing, emergency, or motion queue.
